sources.title: AI that reads between the lines - Textgain
sources.snippet: AI that reads between the lines Textgain uses state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology to analyse and understand digital content. Our mission is to develop advanced AI solutions that are powerful enough to identify harmful content such as violent speech and foreign information manipulation across digital media.

sources.title: GLiNER2.5: Open-Source Information Extraction Model - fastino.ai
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5 is an open-source model for schema-driven information extraction, including efficient entity and relation extraction with no fixed span-length limit.
